notes: Background: mid-market product company (B2B SaaS) focused on in-app search for complex product catalogs.
Primary ask: improve product listing relevance; want a rerank endpoint to apply model-based signals to candidate sets returned by Elastic.
Why Redwood: attracted to hosted API for quick integration, but wants path to Dedicated when traffic and SLAs require it.
Latency/throughput: target p95 < 120ms for rerank calls at 10k QPS peak (batching acceptable), average QPS expected ~1.2k during business hours.
Cost sensitivity: high — product margins thin; interested in quantization/recommendations to reduce token-unit costs.
Model preferences: open-models first (Llama 3 variants), willing to evaluate Redwood-verified smaller variants for reranking layer.
Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to cheaper model if Dedicated pool saturated; region routing for EU customers.
Security: strict audit requirements, SSO via SAML, want KMS integration for keys, retention controls for PII removal from logs.
POC scope: offline eval on historical clickthrough + purchase labels, then online A/B in staging using 5% traffic, compare NDCG/CTR uplift.
Quote from Head of Product: 'We need consistent gains in relevance without blowing up latency — preferring a rerank service that plugs into our pipeline.'
Engagement notes: AE did two demos (12/05, 01/10). SE session 01/15 covered dataset requirements and batching strategies.
Action items: SE to provide sample rerank request/response schema; Redwood to run offline scoring on provided eval set and return baseline metrics.
